nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Blue Serum

avis.texte: I love this line! Great for my mature skin and leaves me so hydrated, but not greasy. I will continue these products for life!
I really wanted to love it because i love this line and brand but it didnt do it for me. Yes it feels fresh, yes its light but i didnt feel moisturizing or do anything for my skin at all.
Grest for my combindation skin type and acne prone skin. Best serum I have tried!

avis.titre: Please do not change or discontinue
avis.texte: Smells good. It helped me with my post acne recovery process. Even during the acne treatment too. Like I said in my Mixsoon review, it upgraded my skin. My skin is moisturized, calmed, plumped and the tone went up(meaning brighter and cleaner)in this harsh Chicago winter. I already purchased another one since it is on sale now(until 21st). When I first purchased it it was not on sale but it is so worth even without the sale.

I have skin that is prone to breakouts and redness. So I'm usually pretty cautious about which products I use on my skin. And I am so happy that I found this product! It adds a lot of hydration and helps calm down any redness. I also have noticed that my breakouts go away faster. The texture is perfect because it absorbs into the skin quick and doesnt leave a sticky residue. Highly recommend this product!
Love how lightweight this serum is. Hydrates without irritating my skin. My skin feels so hydrated and smooth after using.

I have been using this serum for quite some time now and I can say it definitely makes a difference in my skin. I love that it's lightweight, and leaves my skin hydrated but not greasy. It doesn't have a strong scent which I also love and it's affordable!

I packed this product as part of a trip to Europe over the holidays because I knew my skin would need more moisture. It did not go well. My face would start to burn a little after application and I actually developed redness from using it. I ended up purchasing different serums on my trip in order to save my skin barrier.

I did receive this product for free to try out. This is my 100% honest thoughts on the Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Blue Serum. I loved how truly hydrating this serum is. I didn't even need my normal moisturizer after using this. Some serums feel sticky after putting it on, thankfully this is not one of them. It left my skin feeling fresh, hydrated, and smooth. I will definitely be purchasing this serum once I run out of my current one. I highly recommend this serum!

I've been using this serum for a bit now and I like it. It's very lightweight, absorbs fast, and doesn't feel sticky on the skin. I use it before moisturizer and it layers well without pilling. It feels calming when I apply it and helps keep my skin hydrated without irritating it. I didn't experience any breakouts or sensitivity, which is always a plus for me. Overall, it's a solid serum that does what it's supposed to do. I'd continue using it and would recommend it if you want something gentle and easy to add into your routine.

avis.titre: I would buy this as a gift for someone!
avis.texte: This serum is so soothing it actually helped calm the redness around my nose!

Disclosure: I received this product for free as part of a sampling program. All opinions are my own. I've tried many hydrating and calming serums, and the Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Blue Serum truly stands out. Compared to other serums I've used, this one feels lighter yet more effective at soothing my skin. Many hydrating serums either feel sticky or clog my pores, but this absorbs quickly and leaves my skin feeling fresh, calm, and deeply hydrated. One of the biggest benefits is how gentle it is. It noticeably helps reduce redness and irritation while strengthening my skin barrier. My skin feels smoother, more balanced, and healthier overall, especially on days when it's stressed or dry. It also layers beautifully under moisturizer and makeup without pilling. Even though I received this product for free, I would absolutely purchase it on my own once I run out. It's become a staple in my skincare routine. I would definitely recommend this serum to friends and family, especially anyone with sensitive, dry, or combination skin looking for hydration without heaviness. Overall, this is a high-quality, calming serum that delivers real results.

This serum has a lightweight, gel-like texture that glides on smoothly and absorbs quickly without any sticky or heavy residue. It feels refreshing on the skin and layers well under moisturizer or sunscreen, making it great for both morning and evening use. In my experience, it does boost skin moisture visibly and helps with overall skin comfort. If your skin tends to feel dehydrated or irritated, this serum is particularly soothing. This is a solid everyday serum that excels in hydration and calming sensitive skin without overwhelming. It's a nice pick if you want a gentle yet effective step that improves moisture and comfort, though results can vary depending on your skin type. Highly recommended for dry, normal, or sensitive skin.

I've tried a lot from this line but the serum is my absolute favourite. It's so thin in consistency making it perfect to layer under makeup and sunscreen without pilling while it hydrates and moisturises my skin, my skin feels so glowy and bouncy thanks to it! Overall, a love especially for the price point!!! Skin1004 kindly gave me this for free so that I could review it.

avis.titre: I would absolutely purchase this product
avis.texte: Great things:This product is very soothing calms redness and irritation Hydrating and lightweight Good for sensitive and acne-prone skin Absorbs quickly, not sticky Not so great: Can be a bit pricey Results are gradual not instant Mild scent may bother sensitive users

Lightweight, soothing, and super hydrating. This serum absorbs quickly and leaves my skin soft, calm, and plump without any greasy feel. It's great for sensitive or irritated skin and layers easily with the rest of my routine.

I've been using this facial serum for a few weeks now, and I'm really impressed with the results. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky feeling. My skin feels more hydrated, smoother, and looks healthier overall. I also noticed an improvement in my skin tone and a natural glow. It works well under makeup and doesn't cause irritation. I would definitely recommend this serum to anyone looking to improve their skincare routine."
Love how hydrating this feels. The splash of water that the serum feels like when putting onto your face feels amazing in the morning.

This serum is overall a very good product, especially if you're looking for something calming and hydrating. The Centella-based formula feels gentle on the skin and helped soothe irritation, and once it fully absorbs, my skin feels comfortable and balanced. I also appreciate that it doesn't cause breakouts or sensitivity. That said, my main downside was the application experience. The texture has a slightly dry or draggy feel, making it a bit difficult to spread evenly across the entire face. I found myself needing to work quickly or use more product than usual to avoid tugging on the skin, which wasn't ideal. Despite this, the serum performs well after application and layers nicely with moisturizer. If you don't mind the initial texture or plan to apply it to damp skin, it can still be a great addition to a skincare routine.

My skin drinks this up! My skin can really dry in the colder months and this has been saving my skin. My skin feels so smooth, plump, and hydrated. The packaging is heavy and luxe and I love that it has a pump.

I have been using this serum for two weeks now. I love how light it feels on my face vs many other serums where I feel like my face cannot breathe. My skin does look so much brighter and definitely feels smoother.

avis.titre: Ooh- Skin So Soft and Supple - I'm Obsessed!
avis.texte: Thank you, SKIN1004 and BzzAgent, for letting me try this Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Blue Serum in exchange for my sincere feedback and review. First of all, let me state that I scanned this product with Yuka, and I almost lost my mind completely when I saw its 100/100 score. This product's ingredients are irreproachably beyond pure. Thank you for keeping it so squeaky clean! That is very important to me. I have been using the Hyalu-Cica Blue Serum for almost two weeks now. I am OBSESSED with it. The cream is lightweight absorbs quickly. The texture is smooth and silky. It leaves my skin feeling very moisturized and supple. There is a new softness to my face that I am loving so much. It is a very gentle formula and feels super hydrating on my normally dry skin. I am also obsessed with the packaging. Ocean vibes for sure. This speaks to its awesome hydration. I totally recommend this serum.I will certainly purchase more.

avis.titre: Another amazing product from the blue cica line
avis.texte: Skin 1004 does it again. This serum has been so effective for my problem areas of enlarged and congested pores. I feel so clean using this as my second step of skincare between cleansing and moisturizing. Highly recommend. Disclaimer: I received this product as part of a free sample program.
I have dry skin but this helped hydrate it. The smell is a little off but it soaked into my skin really nicely.

avis.titre: Decent serum but not for me
avis.texte: I like the feel of it and the smell but I will say I had some break outs with it. I applied it after cleansing and toning, but before my moisturizer. It didn't burn or sting, but a few days after using, I had some breakouts on my cheek and chin. My skin also felt a bit more dry even with my tried and true moisturizer. I'm not sure this is the serum for me. It isn't overpowering for smell and a little goes a long way. It may work for other people but my skin can be extra sensitive. The gel consistency also makes it easier to put on.

I use this serum after cleansing & toning just before moisturizing. The way it plumps my skin and gives a boost of hydration is 🤌🏽 its a very light gel type of texture.. absorbs into skin well. It brings life to skin. I love it.

SKIN1004 sent me this serum for free through the BzzAgent program so I could try it and share my honest thoughts. I have been using this serum for several days and have really enjoyed it. The texture is very light and absorbs quickly into my skin. My skin feels calm and hydrated after applying with a soothing sensation. The scent is very subtle. My skin looks smoother and feels more balanced after use. I have had less dryness around my nose and some redness is toned down after use.
and layers well with other skincare products. As for the scent it's super faint to where I can only smell it when I first dispense the serum once rub it in it's gone.

I received this product for free to try out from BzzAgent. I have been using this for about a week and ive already noticed an improvement in my skin! My skin feels very hydrated and my makeup lays on my face so much better since ive started using this. Ive always had dry patches on the corners of my nose and this has helped tremendously. I have been using every morning. I highly recommend and will be purchasing for myself!

Tried this for a few days after receiving a free product. It's very very lightweight, and it dries fairly fast. It leaves no sticky or heavy residue, which is really nice. It provides lasting hydration. Over the last few days I've been using it, my skin is on the calmer side with more hydration, especially during this cold, dry weather. Great value and result for the price!

The Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Blue serum is really lightweight. The serum comes in a pump bottle and is super easy to use on face. The serum has pure centella from Madagascar to give hydration to skin. The serum comes in a pump bottle and is easy to dispense in hands to apply all over the face before moisturizer. My skin after use feel light hydrating and helps absorb my moisturizer faster.

I love how many benefits this serum has. The first time I used it I couldn't feel not only how light it felt on my skin but also the instant benefits it brings out. I use it both AM & PM everyday and it's my new "go to!"

Such a calming + hydrating serum! I liked this product from the very first use. It absorbs super fast and keeps my skin hydrated all day. The soothing effect is great — it really helps reduce inflammation, which is perfect for my sensitive skin. I also enjoy the very light, fine scent. I usually avoid fragrance in skincare, but this one feels soft and comfortable. And of course, I love the natural ingredient Centella Asiatica, which always works well for calming my skin. I was impressed from the start, so I purchased more after finishing my first bottle. Highly recommend! 💙

avis.titre: My take on this amazing serum
avis.texte: I received this product for free from Madagascar Centella through the BzzAgent sampling program so I could try it out and share an honest review. Okay , this serum surprised me in the best way. It's lightweight, cooling, and sinks in almost immediately, which I love because I can go straight into moisturizer or makeup without feeling like I'm wearing anything heavy. The texture feels silky, not sticky, and it gives that soft-hydrated look that makes skin look naturally fresh instead of shiny. I've been using it daily and my skin has been consistently calm, hydrated, and smoother to the touch. I especially appreciated how gentle it felt on days when my face was a little more reactive than normal. No burning, no redness, just a soothing glide and a hydrated finish. It plays really well with the rest of my routine too and no pilling under sunscreen or foundation, which is always a deal-breaker for me. The bottle is also gorgeous on a vanity and dispenses the perfect amount so nothing goes to waste. Overall, this felt like a serum I could reach for every day without overthinking it — simple, hydrating, and gentle enough for sensitive skin. If you're into lightweight hydrating serums with a calming feel, this one fits that vibe perfectly. This is my genuine experience, and I'm glad I had the chance to try it.

avis.titre: Lightweight and calming serum with real Madagascar Centella
avis.texte: I used the Hyalu-Cica Blue Serum from SKIN1004 for several days, and my experience was positive. The texture is very light and absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky feeling. I especially liked its calming effect — my skin felt fresher and more comfortable after application. The hydration is gentle but consistent, making it a good option for sensitive skin or anyone who prefers mild, non-irritating formulas. The scent is barely noticeable, which I appreciate. I didn't see dramatic changes overnight, but I did notice a steady sense of softness and comfort. Overall, it's a pleasant and balanced product that works well for daily routines.I received it for free, It was a gift .

I received this product for free for my honest review. This serum works amazing and smells delicious without being overpowering. My skin feels soft and light after using it. Can't wait to try more from them.

I had high hopes for this serum. It feels a little dry and sticky when applied. Once dry I don't really notice a big difference in hydration on my skin and feel like I need to use a lot of it to feel like I'm applying anything. It doesn't make it feel worse and does smooth the texture a little. I received this item for my honest review.

Lightweight, soothing, and great for sensitive skin. This serum absorbs quickly and gives a nice boost of hydration without feeling sticky. It helped calm my redness after a few uses. The bottle is a bit small, but for the sale price it's definitely worth it.

avis.titre: I am in love with this product!!
avis.texte: I love this serum so much! I was sent this product from Skin1004 through BzzAgent free in exchange for an honest review. I am so happy I got to try this because now I'm in love with it. The serum has a water-gel texture and is super cooling and calming to my skin. It has 5 different types of hyaluronic acid and plant extracts that make my skin feel super moisturized. This is so soothing to my skin. It's gentle enough for sensitive skin and works wonders to retain moisture. I will definitely purchase another bottle when I run out of this one.

First of all, love the packaging...simple but cute! This gel-like serum feels amazing on the skin and gives so much hydration! It absorbs nicely and doesn't leave your skin feeling sticky! I'm a combination girly so this helped with my dry patches and that's a huge plus for me! I love that it's lightweight and has 5 layers of Hyaluronic acid which provides long lasting hydration! Not to mention all the other goodies in this serum that also calm and soothe skin! Last but not least I love the smell of this, that's an added bonus for sure! I will definitely continue to use this serum and look forward to even more great results!

I received the product from Skin1004 for free in exchange for my honest review. I like the design of the packaging as it gives a clean and natural look. The serum is moisturizing and quickly absorbed. The scent is also natural and tender. Like it.

I enjoyed using this moisturizing serum. The product isn't greasy at all and it absorbs into the skin fast. My skin felt very nourished and smooth after using it. I would recommend it to anyone wanting to add a simple step into their face care routine.

avis.titre: I will buy this blue serum again
avis.texte: After cleaning face I used to the blue serum waiting for a while continuing wrinkle cream. Just using for couple day days I felt my skin soft more hydrated.

The serum leaves face extremely dewy after application, if you're into that. This would be perfect for you. I like the nice simple moisturized look, but this made it look like I just lathered 15 serums on my face.

This serum is not heavy, has a lightweight texture and feels super hydrating and moisturising. Made my skin feel much more balanced and less red and sensitive. It hasn't triggered any breakouts and is super gentle. One thing I didn't expect from this was the smell, It sort of smells likes like cotton candy, I love it so much.
I use this product day and night on a clean face. It really keeps my skin moisturized all day without a single worry especially since it's cold where I live.
That this product is a good value and has a lot of product in it. It does a good job of keeping my face moisturized and doesn't feel too heavy or greasy.
I absolutely love this product! My skin feels so soft! It's perfect for the winter season. Highly recommend!
It's very lightweight and has a nice finish to it! It is a bit scented and absorbs quickly!

Skin1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Vica Blue serum is very suitable for sensitive, dehydrated and easily irritated skin. After I used it, I felt my skin was effectively rehydrated. It made my skin look smooth and supple after 1 week of use. I really love it.

I received this product for free from BzzAgent in exchange for my honest review. I've been using it for a couple of days now, and so far I'm really liking it. The serum feels lightweight, absorbs fast, and doesn't leave any sticky or heavy feeling on my skin. My face looks a bit more refreshed and calm in the morning, and it gives a nice boost of hydration without overwhelming my skin. It's only been a few days, but the early results are promising. I'm excited to keep using it and see how my skin improves over time.

avis.titre: No more red blotches & healthy glow!
avis.texte: I'm 59 and have been using this for many months now. I have noticed a huge difference in the clarity of my skin & redness. I put it on my face right after shower, give it a few minutes then moisturize. My friends even noticed how good my skin looks!

I received this serum and a lotion as a deluxe sample after purchasing a certain amount and I'm so thankful I did! This serum along with the lotion has made my skin baby soft and glowy, it gives you glass skin. Absolutely will be returning to purchase these from now on. Funny thing is, I actually hated a serum I purchased with my order but LOVED this one.
Please go buy this!!! It feels so good and nourishing. It's like hyaluronic, acid's older more sophisticated sister. I never wrote reviews but this was such a gem that I wanted to share!

This is a very hydrating and non sticky hyaluronic acid serum, with the added benefits of cica. This in conjunction with the luxurious matching cream is a great daytime or barrier repair routine for those with dry and sensitive skin like me.

I tried this in combination with the lotion from the same line. My skin looks the best it has ever looked and credit is all due to these products. My skin is now baby smooth, hydrated and clear. Customer for life. I love this brand!

I'm halfway though my second bottle and will definitely be buying another. I'm know skincare is personal and things work for different people but I am so shocked by the negative reviews. This plumps and hydrates my skin so well. It absorbs wells and feels refreshing. One of my favorite serums.
I haven't noticed any difference using this. I'm disappointed given the price.

avis.titre: buy it if you want but have a backup serum
avis.texte: I had really high expectations for this serum but when I used it I think it was irritating my skin, I really wanna try it again but wanna make sure my skins doing good to see if it was the serum.
I had much better results using the HA serum from the Ordinary. This one might as well had been water.

This has all the ingredients in a serum I could ever want. It intensely hydrates, evens skin tone, balances oil production, plumps out fine lines and wrinkles. It does it ALL. And to top it off, it smells AMAZING - exactly like a blue raspberry jolly rancher - with ZERO artificial fragrance. The smell comes fron natural extracts, not essential oils or anything potentially irritating. It isn't overwhelming, and it also dissipates quickly. I've been super happy with all skin1004 products I've tried, but this is by far my favorite.
Love this peoduct… hate this price… This whole line retails for under 20$ on their website… dont waist your money

avis.titre: A Must Have for Dry Skin Girlies and for aging skin
avis.texte: Not one complaint about this. This is a great step in a skincare routine and boosts hydration greatly. I use after my micellar water and before my fenty toner serum. Chef's kiss, baby!

This product is sooo good. Its lightweight, absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin glowing! I use it at night and I wake up feeling so refreshed. A must have for dry skin like mine!!! I'm so happy this is sold at Ulta now :) We need their sunscreen next!
I have been using this formula and my skin absolutely loves it! Very light and hydrating, doesn't leave your skin feeling gross, overall a must buy. i'm so happy ulta starting selling it

This serum is wonderful and I'm so happy its at Ulta now! It sinks into the skin evenly, doesnt pill, isnt sticky, and is perfect as an added layer of moisture under other treatments or cream based moisturizers. I use it am an pm. Gives my skin a beautiful "bounce" and glow. Everything in this line is amazing. Perfect balance of acids to moisturizers.
